title: Hula Hank's Key West Tipsy Tiki Sunset Cruise
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Valid ID is required for those guests greater than 21 years of age wishing to partake in alcoholic beverages.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Imagine gliding over gentle waves aboard the Lazy Lady, a 53-foot, one of a kind tiki boat. Soak in the vibrant colors of an iconic Key West sunset - hues of orange, pink and purple. 

Sip on ice-cold beverages prepared by your friendly crew while the warm sea breeze carries the sounds of island music and laughter. The atmosphere is relaxed and festive, perfect for making new friends or sharing moments with loved ones. Expect a laid-back and enjoyable trip while unwinding with a refreshing beverage from the bar.

As the last sliver of sun disappears below the water, watch for the green flash, an enchanting touch of magic. Sail back to Key West Harbor under the star-filled sky, creating a Key West memory to last a lifetime.
